reason: I travel twice a month and loose capsule bottles are a pain in my bag, so counted sachets I can take in a hotel room are what get me. $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy, and the empty-box guarantee means I am not stuck if it does nothing.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is one of those things where I could take it for 30 days and notice nothing, and then I have spent the money anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a creator I trust show a real before and after on sleep, or a clearer promise on what I should notice by week two.
